title: A glider gains height

knows: Animals have structures and activities that can be studied.
doesNotKnow: The schematic combines two vertical motions: the bird sinks 1 m/s relative to the air, while the air rises 2 m/s. Adding the signed velocities gives a 1 m/s rise relative to the ground. This is a toy model, not a measurement of a particular bird.

misconception: The features shown in this question have only one possible interpretation.
objective: In a simplified model a gliding bird sinks 1 m/s relative to the air. If the air rises 2 m/s, how does its height change relative to the ground?

claims.text: The air itself can move. In a simplified model a gliding bird sinks 1 m/s relative to the air. If the air rises 2 m/s, how does its height change relative to the ground?
